disclosures.detail: While probing POSIX ACL support on the Data volume I issued chmod +a "everyone deny list" against the repository root directory. That command WROTE an ACL rather than merely testing support. It was detected immediately and reverted with chmod -a. Verification confirms the ACL entry is removed, the source tree is clean, and HEAD is unchanged at 9716656ee47fb04bf8bd6e842982d78b6490cca8. No production or source content was modified; the effect was filesystem metadata only and is entirely reverted.
disclosures.item: inadvertent filesystem ACL mutation, fully reverted

disclosures.detail: Artifacts report only structural facts: account counts, uid classes, ownership classes and permission shapes. No password, key, token or environment secret was accessed or emitted. sudo was probed for password-requirement only and never used to execute anything.
This commission named the launch tip exactly, unlike HQ221/HQ222 where the commission text named its own parent. No tip discrepancy arose.

Read-only shell inventory plus a pre-existing local stdlib-only Python 3.11.3 venv for artifact emission. No governed environment was named by this commission. This is reproduced inventory evidence, not governed certification.

disposition_reason: The commission instructs: if genuine independent principal separation cannot be established on the Mac, return BLOCKED, propose physical/human separation, and do not fake independence. It cannot: exactly one human principal administers this machine (sole uid>=500 account, sole admin, console user, holder of the sudo credential), FileVault is OFF so there is no at-rest confidentiality boundary, and no verifier service, installer or root distribution channel exists at any privilege level. A root LaunchDaemon would give a distinct RUNTIME principal but the same single human would install it, so independent CONTROL is not established.

minimal_recommended_next_decision.blocking_prerequisite: physical/human separation: a second independently administered host or principal for the verifier side, with root material distributed out-of-band; or at minimum enable FileVault, provision a dedicated non-human service account, and place the verifier on different hardware under a different administrator
then: HQ designates one competent C1-01 owner candidate (distinct decision)
HQ separately designates the verifier installation authority (distinct decision)
designated owner proposes exact placement, genesis and epoch
owner installs writer and separately distributed verifier root
